meta.source: Figma: HackIllinois 2027 Design System (Style Guide 2027, Web/Mobile Design System) and HackIllinois 2027 Registration hi-fi screens
meta.reduced: Motion tokens may carry a 'reduced' value. The build emits it under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and :root[data-motion="reduce"], so reduced motion is decided here, in one place.
meta.type: Each type style compiles to --type-<name> (a font shorthand: weight size/line-height family) and --tracking-<name>. Components write font:var(--type-x);letter-spacing:var(--tracking-x).
meta.refs: A value may reference another token as {name}, whole or inline (shadow-sign is '0 3px 0 {wood-deep}'). It compiles to var(--name), resolved where the theme is set (the root), so only reference theme-invariant tokens from string values.
meta.asset: Tokens in the `asset` family compile to --<name> like any other token, themed ones per theme. A relative url() inside a custom property resolves against whichever stylesheet or page USES it, not the one that declares it, so art urls are root-absolute.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything (Style Guide 'Everything at noon' purple; night = Registration review screen #3B419C). Only display titles, eyebrows and on-ground text sit directly on it.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: App bar, timer strip and sticky action bar: a darker band of the ground.

tokens.name: ground-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track and count pills on ground-deep (timer track, tab counts, role switch). Decorative; text on it uses on-ground.

tokens.name: on-ground
tokens.usage: Text and icons directly on ground or ground-deep (9:1+).

tokens.name: on-ground-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground, on the painting and on ground-deep (a lede): 90% white, at least 4.5:1 on the lightest 3% of the scrimmed painting behind it, 7:1 and up on the flat ground. Never smaller than 13px.

tokens.name: sky-1
tokens.usage: Top band of the decorative sky strip (plum at sunset).

tokens.name: sky-2
tokens.usage: Second sky band (terracotta at sunset).

tokens.name: sky-3
tokens.usage: Third sky band (sun glare).

tokens.name: sky-4
tokens.usage: Bottom sky band (gold).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Poster paper. Every content card, sheet and table sits on it (wanted-poster cream from the 2027 Theme Moodboard). Text on it: ink, ink-soft, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Aged paper: inputs, chips, table headers, unselected options on a paper card.

tokens.name: hover-tint
tokens.usage: Hover and press wash for ghost buttons, disclosure heads and clickable table rows on paper.

tokens.name: hover-tint-on-wood
tokens.usage: Hover and press wash for ghost buttons and links on wood (app bar, action bar, signposts, admin header).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and numerals on surface and surface-sunken: the Figma Style Guide's 'Bodytext / Outlines' #3D2B54 exactly (12.6:1 on white, 11.5:1 on surface). The one dark of the brand: on-gold, focus, ground-deep (sunset), hover-tint and on-room-a are this value.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-sunken, and any 12px secondary text (6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and meta on paper (5.3:1 on surface-sunken).

tokens.name: ink-sign
tokens.usage: Lettering on the light wooden signs of the signpost art (art-signpost): the signs are tan (lightness 0.20 to 0.47), so cream would vanish; near-black plum reads at 3.7:1 on the very darkest grain pixel and 4.6:1 at the 1% mark alone, and at 5.5:1 or more on every pixel once the sign-scrim glow is under it. Never on paper (use ink), never on dark wood or the plates of a signpost with no art (use on-wood).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and frames on paper.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on paper (3.8:1 on surface-sunken). A border only: never text (use ink-muted for tertiary text).

tokens.name: ledge
tokens.usage: Hard offset under cards (the dark 'ledge' in the Registration hi-fi).

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Saloon plank: app bar, action bar, admin header, signposts (Figma Website signpost nav, moodboard saloon signs). Text on it: on-wood.

tokens.name: wood-deep
tokens.usage: Shadowed plank under the app bar (timer band), plank edges and nail heads.

tokens.name: wood-hi
tokens.usage: Lighter grain stripe inside wood planks. Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-wood
tokens.usage: Cream sign lettering on wood (7.8:1 on wood, 11.3:1 on wood-deep).

tokens.name: on-wood-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary lettering on wood (labels, timer caption).

tokens.name: rope
tokens.usage: Rope dividers and the rosette ring. Decorative only.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Sheriff star and nail heads. Decorative only; text never sits on it.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (with on-gold), timer fill and the undo fuse. Never a warning: the offline strip uses warn-tint.

tokens.name: gold-glow
tokens.usage: Halo around the sun in the cover illustration (gold at 30%, a plain color so it needs no color-mix). Decorative only; never behind text.

tokens.name: gold-on-ground
tokens.usage: Gold used as TEXT on ground/ground-deep (step labels, "Below the line", live dot). Night is lighter so 12px text stays >= 4.5:1 (5.0:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold (6.4:1).

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid select, success, pro or danger fills (selected score segment, recorded check, the solid danger button: 6.5:1).

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Identity accent: cover blocks, sky band, Pro path marks over 24px. Not for small text (3.3:1).

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: High-emphasis outline (Style Guide): selected chip/card ring and selected text (8.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: select-tint
tokens.usage: Sun-glare wash behind selected chips, cards and options.

tokens.name: pro
tokens.usage: Pro path text (terracotta darkened to 5.0:1 on its own pro-tint badge over paper, 5.8:1 on paper, 6.4:1 on white; the badge at 12px held only 4.5:1 before, and 4.48 on rendered pixels). Always with the word Pro.

tokens.name: pro-tint
tokens.usage: Pro badge fill.

tokens.name: general
tokens.usage: General path text (purple). Always with the word General.

tokens.name: general-tint
tokens.usage: General badge fill, 'Scored' status.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring on controls inside cards. On ground the ring is on-ground (white).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Timer under 10 min (inside cards), Waitlisted, soft flags (6.3:1).

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Warn badge fill and the offline strip (always composited over surface).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Hard flags, Rejected, destructive actions, time-up. Always with icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger badge and alert fill.

tokens.name: alert-on-ground
tokens.usage: Urgent/over text on ground-deep (timer under 2 min, time up). 7.4:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: alert-fill
tokens.usage: Urgent fills on ground-deep: timer bar under 2 min, danger tab count. Text on it uses on-alert-fill.

tokens.name: on-alert-fill
tokens.usage: Text on alert-fill (7.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Admitted, vote recorded, saved (teal from the character palette, off the red-green axis; 5.8:1).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success badge fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets, and over the painted ground (art-ground) so text that sits directly on it reads: white text stays at least 4.5:1 on the lightest pixel of either painting under this scrim (sunset 5.7:1, night 6.1:1; the suite re-measures it on the pixels under every title, eyebrow and lede). Never a fill for content: content sits on paper.

tokens.name: plank-scrim
tokens.usage: A veil of wood-deep between a plank's art (art-plank-*) and the cream lettering on it (wood buttons, the inline Wayfinding sign): a pseudo-element above the border-image and under the label, full strength between the end caps and fading to nothing across each cap so no edge shows. The grain's thin gold highlights are the only pixels that hold cream under 4.5:1 (2% of the plank, down to 2.1:1); under this veil every pixel under the lettering holds 4.8:1 or more (median 8.5:1), measured on real screenshots of every wood button and inline sign, theme-independent. Its fade is drawn in wood-deep, never in the text colour, so hiding the text never hides the veil. Never a fill for content.

tokens.name: sign-scrim
tokens.usage: A soft paper glow (blurred, inside the lettering box) behind the dark ink-sign lettering on the signpost art: the darkest tan grain (lightness 0.19) holds ink-sign at only 4.3:1 alone, 3.7:1 on the very darkest pixel; with this glow every pixel under the lettering of the hero sign holds 5.5:1 or more (median 8:1), measured on real screenshots. The glow is under the text and the art file is untouched. Used only while the art is showing: a loading or failed signpost letters on flat wood plates instead.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Table talk recording: the record control, the 'Recording' dot and word. The same red as danger (no new hue), named for its job; always with the word 'Recording'.

tokens.name: rec-ring
tokens.usage: The calm pulse ring around the record control while recording (scale and opacity breathe on dur-rec-pulse; static under reduced motion). Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: viewfinder
tokens.usage: The camera viewfinder behind a placard scan (TableCheck). A camera feed stands in here, not a fifth material: only the frame, the scan line and on-viewfinder text sit on it.

tokens.name: on-viewfinder
tokens.usage: Text and corner brackets on the viewfinder (18:1).

tokens.name: room-a
tokens.usage: Placard band for Room 4217 (A, 'Gold'). Print only: the colour band and room letter on TablePlacard; text on it is on-room-a.

tokens.name: on-room-a
tokens.usage: Text on the room-a band (6.4:1).

tokens.name: room-b
tokens.usage: Placard band for Room 4218 (B, 'Teal').

tokens.name: on-room-b
tokens.usage: Text on the room-b band (5.9:1).

tokens.name: room-c
tokens.usage: Placard band for Room 4219 (C, 'Rose').

tokens.name: on-room-c
tokens.usage: Text on the room-c band (5.6:1).

tokens.name: room-d
tokens.usage: Placard band for Room 1404 (D, 'Sage').

tokens.name: on-room-d
tokens.usage: Text on the room-d band (6.0:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles on ground (on-ground with shadow-title) and the project name on the ProjectHeader poster. Style Guide Header 1 is Ultra 40 on web; 28 on phones.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Celebration and desktop titles (Style Guide Header 1, Ultra Regular 40).

styles.name: cover-name
styles.usage: The product name on the Cover illustration's saloon sign: illustration scale (twice display-lg), nowhere else.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Names on compare cards and My notes items; compact screen titles (My notes, Rank the finalists, the compare question).

styles.name: room-hero
styles.usage: Room number on the hero Wayfinding sign. Oswald reads like a trail sign from arm's length.

styles.name: sign
styles.usage: The room or table value on the hero signpost's right-hand arrow sign (Wayfinding size=hero). Smaller than room-hero so it sits on a sign 280px wide, still readable from arm's length.

styles.name: count-hero
styles.usage: Countdown digits before judging begins (tabular).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Admin section titles on ground (Style Guide Header 2, Oswald Regular 36), with shadow-title.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Admin StatTile value.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Signpost table ('Table A12'), sheet titles, empty-state titles (Style Guide Header 3, Oswald 24).

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Flag names, check-in values, Round 2 finalist names, the wordmark size.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Countdown, tabular numerals.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Large (lg) buttons: the one forward action on a judge screen; score digits.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label, uppercase (Web Buttons).

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Uppercase links, tabs, small (sm, admin-only) buttons, mono badges and meta.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Table/room numbers, counts.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overline; gold on ground, ink-soft in cards.

styles.name: placard-code
styles.usage: The table code on a printed placard (TablePlacard), readable from across the aisle. Print only.

styles.name: placard-check
styles.usage: The 2-character check printed after the code on a placard ('A12 · K7'). Print only; the app never shows it before arrival.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions, notes, ledes, taglines (Style Guide Body Text, Manrope; 20 on web, 16 on phones so iOS never zooms). Manrope has no italic: never set it italic.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card titles and accordion rows (Registration review).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Rows, table cells, chips, helper text (at weight 400), toasts and alerts (at 600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, field status, table sub-lines (at 400). Field labels on judge screens use body-sm at 600.

styles.name: read-aloud
styles.sample: Okay if my phone takes notes while you demo?
styles.usage: A script the judge reads out loud (the Table talk consent sheet): big enough to read at arm's length in a loud room.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top space.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Chamfer width on phone controls (Mobile Design System: 8w corners).

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Chamfer on cards and large controls on phones.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Chamfer on web controls (Web Design System dev note: 16w x 12h corners).

tokens.name: arrow-tip
tokens.usage: Depth of the point on arrow-shaped back/next buttons and signpost arrows. The notch at the other end is cut-md.

tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: Radius of the half-circle bites in a ticket stub (the compare order tag). The edge is feathered by an eighth of it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Outlined controls on paper (chips, fields, options, selects, score, secondary buttons) where a chamfer would cut the outline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, disclosures, toasts and confirms where corner-shape: bevel is unsupported.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, dots, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Hard ledge under cards and buttons on ground (Registration hi-fi).

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-lg
tokens.usage: Selected compare card, sheets, sticky bars.

tokens.name: shadow-title
tokens.usage: text-shadow on display titles (Registration 'Application Submitted!').

tokens.name: shadow-plank
tokens.usage: Under wooden planks and signposts: a hard edge plus a soft cast shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sign
tokens.usage: text-shadow under sign lettering on wood (wordmark, hero room number): a carved edge in wood-deep (referenced, not repeated).

tokens.name: shadow-plank-edge
tokens.usage: Hard edge under a wood plank that sits on top (app bar, admin header).

tokens.name: shadow-plank-edge-up
tokens.usage: Hard edge above a wood plank pinned to the bottom (action bar, compare confirm bar).

tokens.name: shadow-rule
tokens.usage: The printed double rule that frames a poster card (pair it with shadow-ledge).

tokens.name: shadow-rosette
tokens.usage: Rope ring and wood edge around a Round 2 rosette (top places).

tokens.name: shadow-star
tokens.usage: drop-shadow under the sheriff star (a filter, so it follows the star shape).

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: Rubber-stamp border on status stamps; takes the stamp color.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of judge-side controls (one hand, walking).

tokens.name: phone-max
tokens.usage: Judge column max width.

tokens.name: admin-max
tokens.usage: Admin content max width.

tokens.name: mark-h
tokens.usage: Height of the HackIllinois lockup (art-lockup) in the judge app bar and the admin header. Its width follows the art (221:73), about 121px; it sits on wood, never on paper.

tokens.name: sign-w
tokens.usage: Width of the hero signpost (art-signpost, 718:1135) on a judge screen. About 443px tall; narrower screens shrink it (max-width 100%).

tokens.name: sign-glyph
tokens.usage: Width of one lettering character on a signpost sign, in em (Oswald capitals and digits, with the sign tracking, are about 0.5 em; this leaves room for a W and for the fallback font). The fit rule: the room, table or noun on a sign is set at min(its type size, sign width / (characters x sign-glyph)), so a longer value shrinks until it fits and never spills over the next sign or the post. A unitless number.

tokens.name: sign-fit-min
tokens.usage: The smallest the fit rule may set a noun on a signpost (Room, Table): beyond it the text keeps this size and ends in an ellipsis. Never below the 13px floor of the type scale.

tokens.name: sign-fit-chars
tokens.usage: How many characters of a room or table value the big arrow sign takes on one line (fit to the sign, 25px at 12). A longer value drops to title-sm on two lines, then an ellipsis, like the project name on the last board. A unitless number; GavIL reads it from the same token.

tokens.name: star-size
tokens.usage: One sheriff-star medallion in the table progress tracker (art-star-*). Decorative: the count is always written beside it.

tokens.name: prop-h
tokens.usage: Height of a prop (wagon, cactus, horseshoe) above an empty or waiting state. Decorative, trimmed to its alpha bounds.

tokens.name: prop-h-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a prop beside a title or in a row (Round 1 complete flanks, admin empty states).

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Compact status and metadata icons that must stay smaller than body copy.

tokens.name: icon-compact
tokens.usage: Small inline icons beside help and secondary labels.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Default icon; inside buttons, links and spinners.

tokens.name: icon-wide
tokens.usage: Inline status and alert icons that need more weight than the default icon.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Card titles, option dots and the recorder's side controls.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Round 2 move arrows, the compare radio, empty-state and result icons.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines: paper frames and rules, table row lines, unselected control edges, the hatch on the coverage meter key.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Edges that must read: outlined secondary buttons, selected chip and option rings, radio rings, the focus outline offset on checkboxes.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings, the selected compare-card ring and the tab underline. Paired rings are sums of strokes (focus + gap + edge).

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Spread of an inset box-shadow that tints a whole surface, so a selection wash can transition (compare cards). Not a length anyone sees.

tokens.name: nail
tokens.usage: Radius of a brass nail head in the wood texture (--gv-nails); its dark rim is half a hairline wider and its shadow ends at space-1. Texture geometry, never layout.

tokens.name: rec-size
tokens.usage: The round record/stop control in Table talk (at least 64px: the one control a judge must hit without looking).

tokens.name: placard-w
tokens.usage: Printed placard width (US Letter with 0.5in margins). Print sheet only.

tokens.name: placard-h
tokens.usage: Printed placard height (one placard per page). The printable height of a Letter page is 10in (11in less 0.5in margins); the placard stops 0.1in short of it, so rounding never pushes a blank page after every placard.

asset.note: Brand art, as CSS custom properties: `--art-*` is a url() rooted at the design-system root (like the /components/bundle.css and /.preview/tokens.css every preview links), so it resolves the same from a stylesheet and from a page's own <style>; `--plank-*` are the numbers the plank 3-slice needs. Files live in assets/brand/ (originals, never redrawn, traced or recolored) and assets/brand/derived/ (resized and re-encoded by scripts/make_brand_derived.py). JS reads the same tokens (GavIL.art). The README says which art goes where. A host that serves the files elsewhere (the Next app serves them from /brand/) overrides these values.

tokens.name: art-ground
tokens.usage: The painted canyon behind the judge shell and the sign-in screen (Registration > General Registration Form: sunset 1 and sunset 7). Drawn cover-fit, fixed under the content, with the scrim token over it (GavIL .gv-ground). 1280 x 832 and 1280 x 1189, re-encoded as WebP (83 and 141 KB); the PNG originals stay in assets/brand/.

tokens.name: art-ground-pos
tokens.usage: Where the painting is anchored when it is cropped to a phone: the sky, the sun or the moon stay in view.

tokens.name: art-h-mark
tokens.usage: The H mark (Registration, hackillinois-main). White: only on ground, wood or night, never on paper. `Brand name="h-mark"` draws it for a bar too narrow for the lockup (which already contains it); no screen places it yet.

tokens.name: art-lockup
tokens.usage: The H mark with the HACK ILLINOIS wordmark (stacked). White: on the wood app bar and the admin header, or on a ground-deep band; never on paper.

tokens.name: art-longhorn
tokens.usage: The longhorn logo, long horns (Style Guide 2027 > logo). Black #231F20, so it sits on paper (the sign-in seal, the Cover), never on ground or wood.

tokens.name: art-longhorn-alt
tokens.usage: The longhorn logo, flat horn bar. Black, on paper. Not used on any screen: the long-horn variant (art-longhorn) is the sign-in seal and the Cover's mark.

tokens.name: art-plank-flat
tokens.usage: A wooden plank with chamfered ends (Registration default plank), cropped to its alpha bounds, 750 x 192. The wood button and labels draw it as a 3-slice border-image: the ends keep their cut, only the grain between stretches.

tokens.name: art-plank-point-right
tokens.usage: An arrow plank whose TIP POINTS RIGHT (swallowtail notch on the left): Next, go here, the inline Wayfinding sign. It is the export named wood-plank-left (the Figma name is the notch side, not the tip): checked on the pixels.

tokens.name: art-plank-point-left
tokens.usage: An arrow plank whose TIP POINTS LEFT: Back. It is the export named wood-plank-right.

tokens.name: plank-art-h
tokens.usage: Height of the plank derivatives in px; the three plank numbers below are in these px.

tokens.name: plank-cap-flat
tokens.usage: Width in px (of art-plank-flat, 192 high) of each chamfered end. border-image-slice for the wood button; its drawn width is this over plank-art-h of the button's height.

tokens.name: plank-cap-arrow
tokens.usage: Width in px (of the arrow planks, 192 high) of the tip and of the notch. border-image-slice for Back, Next and the inline Wayfinding sign.

tokens.name: plank-cut-x
tokens.usage: The flat plank's end cut across, as a fraction of its height (68 / 192). The wood button's clip-path takes the same cut, so the focus ring follows the art's edge.

tokens.name: plank-cut-y
tokens.usage: The flat plank's end cut down, as a fraction of its height. See plank-cut-x.

tokens.name: plank-tip
tokens.usage: Depth of an arrow plank's tip and of its notch as a fraction of its height (96 / 192): the clip-path of Back, Next and the inline Wayfinding sign.

tokens.name: plank-ring-apex
tokens.usage: How far the point of a 45-degree arrow plank (its tip, or the notch cut into its other end) moves along the plank's axis for each px the focus ring is inset from the edge: 1 / sin(45deg) = the square root of 2. Used only by the wood button's focus ring, which is the plank's own polygon inset twice; derived from plank-tip (the suite recomputes all three from it).

tokens.name: plank-ring-k135
tokens.usage: How far the corner where an arrow plank's straight edge meets its 135-degree turn (tip side) moves along that edge, per px of inset: tan(22.5deg). See plank-ring-apex.

tokens.name: plank-ring-k45
tokens.usage: How far the corner where an arrow plank's straight edge meets the notch's 45-degree turn moves along that edge, per px of inset: 1 / tan(22.5deg). See plank-ring-apex.

tokens.name: art-signpost
tokens.usage: The blank wooden signpost, 718 x 1135 (2x), five tan signs on a post. The hero Wayfinding and EnRoute letter it with live text: the signs' places are percentages in bundle.css (.gv-sign). Lettering is ink-sign.

tokens.name: art-star-filled
tokens.usage: Sheriff star, filled: a table judged. A 96-px-at-2x medallion cut from progress-stars.png (the sheet's dark tile is part of the art).

tokens.name: art-star-half
tokens.usage: Sheriff star, half filled: the table you are at.

tokens.name: art-star-outline
tokens.usage: Sheriff star, outline: a table still to come.

tokens.name: art-garland-ground
tokens.usage: Garland divider for the painted ground: cream horses on a line (Progress Bars sheet). Decorative (aria-hidden); cream is at least 3:1 on the scrimmed ground in both themes, measured.

tokens.name: art-garland-paper
tokens.usage: Garland divider for paper: brown horses on a line. Decorative.

tokens.name: art-wagon
tokens.usage: Covered wagon prop (Website > Prizes): the waiting state and empty states.

tokens.name: art-horseshoe
tokens.usage: Gold horseshoe prop: Round 1 complete.

tokens.name: art-cactus-tall
tokens.usage: Tall prickly-pear prop: empty states.

tokens.name: art-cactus-round
tokens.usage: Round prickly-pear cluster prop: Round 1 complete and empty states.

tokens.name: art-cactus-bushes
tokens.usage: Two cactus clumps meant for the left and right page edges (cut by the Figma frame, as in the source). Not used on any screen: a footer edge decoration candidate; `Prop name="cactus-bushes"` can draw it.

tokens.name: art-neon-board
tokens.usage: The neon HACK ILLINOIS marquee (Website > Landing). It glows on a dark ground: it sits on the countdown screen (it reads at 390px on both paintings under the scrim, drawn sign-w wide) and on the Cover at Night. 560 x 328, 47 KB.

tokens.name: art-neon-arrow
tokens.usage: The neon arrow and post that carry the marquee. Not used on any screen (nothing references it, so no phone downloads its 104 KB): the marquee alone is the sign, and the post would need a canvas taller than the Cover. Derived once so a later screen needs no re-export.

tokens.name: art-character-teal
tokens.usage: Character: teal sphere in a cowboy hat (Design System > Characters). Used by the Cover only, beside the name sign (the sign-in screen carries the longhorn seal, not a character). 9 KB; no raster twin is needed.

tokens.name: art-character-orange
tokens.usage: Character: orange block in a cowboy hat. Not used on any screen: 591 KB and a whole-frame viewBox, so it is a candidate for a later empty state, never a judge screen (lazy-load it and trim it in CSS, never in the file). The Cover uses the teal character.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.usage: Motion switch. Multiply decorative movement by it (rotate, scale, translate, blur). 0 under reduced motion; JS reads it too (GavIL.motionOK).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or answering a tap: press release, toasts, screen and card enter, check marks.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moving between two places on screen: Round 2 swaps (FLIP).

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets opening and snapping back after a drag (iOS drawer curve).

tokens.name: ease-stamp
tokens.usage: The sheriff star landing: a slight overshoot, then rest.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Leaving only (sheet and toast exits at dur-exit). Never for entrances.

tokens.name: ease-pulse
tokens.usage: Opacity pulses only (skeleton, urgent timer dot): a gentle sine in-out. Never for movement.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Press-in on :active, so a 60 ms thumb tap still shows the full press.

tokens.name: dur-release
tokens.usage: Press release, selection and color changes, icon cross-fades.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Tabs and table-row washes, small color changes on dense admin UI.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Disclosure open, chevrons, the countdown tick.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Screen, card and toast enter; reorder swap.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet enter and snap-back.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Sheets and toasts leaving: always shorter than the enter. Tests require a sheet gone within 180 ms.

tokens.name: dur-stamp
tokens.usage: Sheriff star landing (twice a night); what follows it waits for it.

tokens.name: dur-attention
tokens.usage: One-shot timer flash on a threshold crossing (opacity only). None under reduced motion: its keyframe starts from half of --motion, which is 0 there.

tokens.name: talk-processing-timeout
tokens.usage: Maximum time to wait for table-talk highlights before showing recovery actions. Product deadline, never reduced.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: A control that appears where the judge just tapped ignores taps this long (double-tap safety). Not reduced: it is safety, not motion.

tokens.name: talk-start-hold
tokens.usage: Longest the judge screen's Submit ignores finger taps while the microphone is starting (the tap that agreed sat over Submit; a second tap is not a submit). Product safety, never reduced; keys and assistive-tech presses always act.

tokens.name: dur-retap
tokens.usage: After a finger closes a sheet, the footprint of the button it pressed keeps absorbing taps this long (the sheet's own action sits over the page's Submit or Skip, and a judge who thinks nothing happened taps again). Covers dur-exit + dur-settle. Not reduced: it is safety, not motion.

tokens.name: dur-delay
tokens.usage: Wait before showing a skeleton or 'Saving…', so fast loads never flash.

tokens.name: dur-toast
tokens.usage: How long a toast stays before it leaves (then dur-exit). Long enough to read one sentence at arm’s length.

tokens.name: dur-autosave
tokens.usage: Notes autosave pause: the remote sync waits this long after the last keystroke. The draft itself is kept on every keystroke and flushed on submit, unmount and reconnect.

tokens.name: dur-undo
tokens.usage: The undo window after a vote: Undo (n) counts it down, the gold fuse drains it, then the vote commits. A product rule, not motion: never reduced.

tokens.name: demo-latency
tokens.usage: Prototype only: simulated network latency (sending a sign-in link, loading the next project). Components never read it.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: Skeleton and urgent-dot pulse period (opacity on ease-pulse; static under reduced motion).

tokens.name: loop
tokens.usage: Iteration count of endless loops: the urgent timer dot, the skeleton pulse and the busy spinner. 0 under reduced motion, so they stop and stay as drawn (the words and aria-busy still say what is happening) instead of running a static loop.

tokens.name: dur-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the busy spinner inside a loading Button or a wait (linear). Endless in full motion; under reduced motion --loop is 0 and the spinner stays still.

tokens.name: dur-tick
tokens.usage: Timer fill transition: linear, matching the 1 s tick.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between siblings entering together; at most 4 steps.

tokens.name: rise
tokens.usage: Enter travel distance for screens, toasts, cards.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons, chips, links, tabs.

tokens.name: press-scale-lg
tokens.usage: Pressed compare cards, option rows, disclosure heads (big surfaces move less).

tokens.name: sheet-offset
tokens.usage: Where a bottom sheet starts and leaves (translateY). 0 under reduced motion, so it fades instead.

tokens.name: flick-distance
tokens.usage: Gesture physics, read by JS (GavIL.tokenMs-style): a sheet dragged down at least this far fast enough (flick-speed) closes, however short the drag. Not reduced: a gesture still works under reduced motion.

tokens.name: flick-speed
tokens.usage: Gesture physics: release speed in px per ms above which a downward drag of at least flick-distance dismisses a sheet (a quick flick is enough; no threshold to reach).

tokens.name: dur-rec-pulse
tokens.usage: One calm breath of the recording ring (scale + opacity on ease-pulse). Slower than the urgent dot: recording is a state, not an alarm. Static under reduced motion (it multiplies by --motion and loops on --loop).

tokens.name: dur-meter
tokens.usage: Level-meter bars follow the mic level (about 15 updates a second). Under reduced motion the meter is words ('Hearing speech' / 'Quiet'), not bars.

tokens.name: dur-cant-find
tokens.usage: Product rule: after 3 minutes en route the signpost offers 'Can't find it?' (floor plan, ask staff). Never reduced.

tokens.name: talk-window
tokens.usage: Product rule: 15 minutes. A memo is offered for 15 minutes after the judge leaves a table, and a recording that waited offline for a connection is discarded unheard when the 15 minutes (counted from leaving the table) are up. Never reduced.

tokens.name: rec-warn
tokens.usage: Product rule: at 7:00 of recording Table talk says 'One minute of recording left'. Never reduced.

tokens.name: rec-cap
tokens.usage: Product rule: recording stops itself at 8:00 and pulls highlights. Never reduced.

tokens.name: demo-talk-rate
tokens.usage: Prototype only: the FixtureEngine plays a sample table conversation this many times faster than real time. Components never read it.

tokens.name: demo-wait
tokens.usage: Prototype only: how long 'All your tables are busy' waits before a table frees up. Components never read it.

breakpoints.note: Viewport widths where a stylesheet changes layout. CSS cannot read a custom property inside @media, so each width is written as a literal (rule 1's one exception); this list is their single source. The suite fails on a @media (max-width) in bundle.css or a preview that is not listed here, and on a listed width nothing uses.

tokens.name: bp-tiny
tokens.usage: Smallest phones: app-bar buttons give up side padding.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: Admin: two-up grids and the definition list become one column.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: The judge prototype's stage: the demo strip is one scrolling row and the phone fills the screen.

tokens.name: bp-rows
tokens.usage: Round 2 rows reflow when container queries are missing.

tokens.name: bp-flag
tokens.usage: Flag cards stack their actions under the reasons.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone: tables stack into labelled cards, laptop-density controls become 48px, gutters tighten.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Admin: two-column layouts become one column.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Tab strips scroll sideways and fade at the edge.
